name: email_pickup_no_matching_email_graceful_handling
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the banking tools
branch: Diana Johnson believes she emailed about the Olive Garden charge TX07, but no such email reached the mailbox (only her unrelated Zara inquiry is there); the assistant searches, tells her nothing matching was found, and disputes TX07 from what she says in chat.
tests: passes when the agent searches the mailbox for Diana's email before acting, the search finds nothing from her about TX07 (only the unrelated Zara thread), it verifies her, files exactly one dispute for TX07, and tells her the email was not found rather than claiming to have read it.
instruction:
